http-status-codes.title: HTTP Status Codes
http-status-codes.description: Quick reference for HTTP status codes
http-status-codes.desc-continue: The client should continue with the rest of the request
http-status-codes.desc-switchingProtocols: The server agrees to switch to the requested protocol
http-status-codes.desc-processing: The request was received and is still being processed (WebDAV)
http-status-codes.desc-earlyHints: Preliminary response headers sent for preloading
http-status-codes.desc-ok: The request succeeded and the response contains the result
http-status-codes.desc-created: The request succeeded and a new resource was created
http-status-codes.desc-accepted: The request was accepted but has not been processed yet
http-status-codes.desc-nonAuthoritative: The response comes from a cache or third party, not the origin server
http-status-codes.desc-noContent: The request succeeded with an empty response body
http-status-codes.desc-resetContent: The request succeeded; ask the client to reset the document view
http-status-codes.desc-partialContent: A Range request returned part of the resource
http-status-codes.desc-multipleChoices: The requested resource has multiple possible locations
http-status-codes.desc-movedPermanently: The resource has permanently moved to a new URL
http-status-codes.desc-found: The resource temporarily lives at a different URL
http-status-codes.desc-seeOther: Fetch the resource from another URL using GET
http-status-codes.desc-notModified: The resource is unchanged; use the client's cached copy
http-status-codes.desc-temporaryRedirect: The resource temporarily lives elsewhere; keep method and body
http-status-codes.desc-permanentRedirect: The resource has permanently moved; keep method and body
http-status-codes.desc-badRequest: The request is malformed and cannot be understood
http-status-codes.desc-paymentRequired: Reserved; usually means payment is needed
http-status-codes.desc-forbidden: The server refuses to fulfill the request
http-status-codes.desc-notFound: The server cannot find the requested resource
http-status-codes.desc-methodNotAllowed: The request method is not supported by the resource
http-status-codes.desc-notAcceptable: No response matches the Accept headers
http-status-codes.desc-proxyAuthenticationRequired: Authenticate with the proxy server first
http-status-codes.desc-requestTimeout: The server timed out waiting for the request
http-status-codes.desc-conflict: The request conflicts with the current state of the resource
http-status-codes.desc-gone: The resource has been permanently removed
http-status-codes.desc-lengthRequired: The Content-Length request header is missing
http-status-codes.desc-preconditionFailed: A request precondition in the headers was not met
http-status-codes.desc-payloadTooLarge: The request body exceeds the size the server allows
http-status-codes.desc-uriTooLong: The request URI is longer than the server can process
http-status-codes.desc-unsupportedMediaType: The request Content-Type is not supported
http-status-codes.desc-rangeNotSatisfiable: The requested Range exceeds the size of the resource
http-status-codes.desc-expectationFailed: The requirement of the Expect header cannot be met
http-status-codes.desc-imATeapot: April Fools joke; the server refuses to brew coffee
http-status-codes.desc-misdirectedRequest: The request was sent to a server unable to produce a response
http-status-codes.desc-upgradeRequired: The client must switch to a higher protocol version
http-status-codes.desc-preconditionRequired: The request must include conditional headers
http-status-codes.desc-tooManyRequests: Rate limit triggered; the client sent too many requests
http-status-codes.desc-requestHeaderFieldsTooLarge: The request headers exceed the server's limits
http-status-codes.desc-unavailableForLegalReasons: Access to the resource was denied for legal reasons
http-status-codes.desc-internalServerError: The server hit an unexpected error
http-status-codes.desc-notImplemented: The server does not support the functionality required
http-status-codes.desc-badGateway: The upstream server returned an invalid response
http-status-codes.desc-serviceUnavailable: The server is overloaded or under maintenance
http-status-codes.desc-gatewayTimeout: The upstream server did not respond in time
http-status-codes.desc-httpVersionNotSupported: The HTTP version used by the request is not supported
http-status-codes.desc-insufficientStorage: The server ran out of storage to complete the request (WebDAV)
http-status-codes.desc-networkAuthenticationRequired: The client must authenticate to gain network access

regex-memo.title: Regex Cheatsheet
regex-memo.item-anchor-start: Match the start of the string
regex-memo.item-anchor-end: Match the end of the string
regex-memo.item-class-not-digit: Any character that is not a digit
regex-memo.item-class-not-word: Any character that is not a word character
regex-memo.item-class-not-whitespace: Any character that is not whitespace
regex-memo.item-class-set: Character set: match any one of them
regex-memo.item-class-negated-set: Negated set: anything except a, b, c
regex-memo.item-quant-min: Preceding item at least n times
regex-memo.item-quant-range: Preceding item between n and m times
regex-memo.item-quant-lazy: Lazy mode: match as few as possible
regex-memo.item-group-backreference: Backreference to the first capture group

git-memo.title: Git Cheatsheet
git-memo.description: Git installation, setup options and command cheatsheet

download.title: Download the installer
download.detail: Grab the 64-bit .exe; use the npmmirror site when git-scm.com is slow
download.code-note: The version number in the filename changes

wizard.title: Wizard screen by screen
wizard.detail: Fourteen screens in order; the left column names the screen, the right one the option to pick
wizard.components-value: Select Components: Desktop Icon and Windows Explorer integration are pre-checked, Next
wizard.start-menu-value: Select Start Menu Folder: keep Git, Next
wizard.editor-value: Choosing the default editor used by Git: Use Vim by default, switch to Use Notepad++ if you dislike the command line
wizard.branch-value: Branch name for new repositories: leave master, or type main if your team standardised on it
wizard.path-value: Adjusting your PATH environment: middle option, Git from the command line and also from 3rd-party software
wizard.ssh-value: Choose SSH executable: keep Use bundled OpenSSH
wizard.https-value: Choose HTTPS transport backend: Use the OpenSSL library, or the native Windows SSL library for the Windows certificate store
wizard.line-endings-value: Configuring the line ending conversions: Checkout Windows-style, commit Unix-style line endings
wizard.terminal-value: Choose the terminal emulator to use with Git Bash: Use MinTTY (the default terminal of MSYS2)
wizard.fetch-value: Choose the default behavior of git pull: keep Default (fast-forward or merge)
wizard.credential-value: Choose a credential helper: Git Credential Manager, so sign-in is remembered
wizard.extras-value: Configuring extra options: leave Enable file system caching and friends on, then Install

verify.title: Verify the install
verify.detail: Run it in a fresh terminal; a version string means Git is on PATH

config.title: First-run identity
config.detail: Commits are rejected without it; --global applies to every repository
config.scope-value: Inside a work repository run the same user.email without --global to override the global identity

git-memo.item-init: Initialize a new repository in the current directory
git-memo.item-clone-branch: Clone a specific branch of a remote repository
git-memo.item-config-name: Set the commit author name for every repository
git-memo.item-config-email: Set the global author email; rerun it without --global inside a repo to switch identity
git-memo.item-commit-amend: Amend the last commit (add changes or edit message)
git-memo.item-rm: Remove files and record the deletion
git-memo.item-switch-create: Create and switch to a new branch
git-memo.item-merge: Merge a branch into the current branch
git-memo.item-cherry-pick: Apply a commit from another branch onto the current one
git-memo.item-rebase: Rebase the current branch onto the target branch
git-memo.item-fetch-prune: Fetch updates and prune stale remote branch references
git-memo.item-pull: Fetch remote updates and merge them into the current branch
git-memo.item-push: Push the current branch to the remote
git-memo.item-push-upstream: Push for the first time and set upstream tracking
git-memo.item-push-force-lease: Force push safely (never clobber others' commits)
git-memo.item-restore: Discard changes to a file in the working tree
git-memo.item-restore-staged: Unstage a file while keeping the changes
git-memo.item-reset-hard: Undo commits and discard all changes
git-memo.item-revert: Undo a commit by creating an inverse commit
git-memo.item-log-oneline: Show the commit history in one line per commit
git-memo.item-log-graph: Show the history of all branches as a graph
git-memo.item-log-file: Show the change history of a file
git-memo.item-show: Show the details of a commit
git-memo.item-blame: Show who last modified each line of a file
git-memo.item-reflog: Show the record of HEAD movements
git-memo.item-tag-show: Show the details of a tag
git-memo.item-tag-push: Push a specific tag to the remote
git-memo.item-tag-push-all: Push all tags to the remote
git-memo.item-stash-message: Stash the current changes with a message
git-memo.item-stash-pop: Apply the latest stash and drop it
git-memo.item-stash-apply: Apply the latest stash and keep it
git-memo.item-stash-branch: Create a branch from a stash entry and restore it

maven-memo.title: Maven Cheatsheet
maven-memo.description: Maven installation steps, common goals and dependency configuration

download.title: Download the archive
download.detail: On the download page grab only a Binary zip archive; the source packages are not needed
download.code-note: The version in the filename changes; pick anything ending in -bin.zip

extract.title: Extract to a fixed directory
extract.detail: Keep the path free of spaces and non-ASCII characters; it should contain bin / conf / lib

env.title: Set environment variables
env.detail: This PC → Properties → Advanced system settings → Environment Variables → System variables: create MAVEN_HOME first, then edit Path

verify.title: Verify the install
verify.detail: Run it in a fresh terminal (existing ones miss the new variables); a Maven version plus Java version means it works

settings.title: Mirror & local repository
settings.detail: Edit <extract dir>\conf\settings.xml: localRepository goes under <settings>, the whole mirror element goes under <mirrors>
settings.note: Mirroring only central keeps your private repositories reachable

idea.title: Point IDEA at this Maven
idea.detail: Settings → Build Tools → Maven; skip this and IDEA keeps using its bundled Maven
idea.override-value: Override, then select the settings.xml above

maven-memo.item-build-clean: Remove target and everything from the previous build
maven-memo.item-build-test: Compile and run the unit tests
maven-memo.item-build-package: Package a jar / war into target
maven-memo.item-build-verify: Run tests plus integration checks, the full pre-release gate
maven-memo.item-build-install: Package and install into the local repository so other projects can depend on it
maven-memo.item-build-deploy: Publish to the remote repository declared in distributionManagement
maven-memo.item-build-clean-install: The everyday combo: clean, then build and install
maven-memo.item-opt-update: Force snapshot updates and retry failed downloads (failures are cached until you pass -U)
maven-memo.item-opt-skip-tests: Skip running tests, but still compile them
maven-memo.item-opt-skip-test-compile: Skip compiling and running tests, more thorough than -DskipTests
maven-memo.item-opt-offline: Offline mode, resolve everything from the local repository
maven-memo.item-opt-debug: Enable debug logging to trace dependency resolution and plugin failures
maven-memo.item-opt-pl: Build only the given module, with -am also building the modules it depends on
maven-memo.item-opt-single-test: Run a single test class or test method
maven-memo.item-opt-repo-local: Use another local repository directory for this build only
maven-memo.item-opt-threads: Build in parallel using one thread per CPU core
maven-memo.item-set-local-repository: Move the local repository off the system drive; the default is ~/.m2/repository
maven-memo.item-set-mirror-aliyun: Aliyun mirror of Central, the usual first choice; paste the whole element inside <mirrors>
maven-memo.item-set-mirror-huawei: Huawei Cloud mirror, a fallback when Aliyun lags
maven-memo.item-set-mirror-of-central: Proxy only Central, private repositories stay reachable (recommended)
maven-memo.item-set-mirror-of-all: Proxy every repository: private repos and other sources get replaced too, use with care
maven-memo.item-set-server: Credentials for deploying to a private repo; the id must match the repository id in distributionManagement
maven-memo.item-set-active-profiles: Activate a profile by default, e.g. to switch JDK or repository set
maven-memo.item-set-effective-settings: Print the settings that actually take effect when an edit seems ignored
maven-memo.item-set-effective-pom: Print the final POM after parent and profile merging
maven-memo.item-set-custom-file: Point at a specific settings file without touching the global default
maven-memo.item-dep-tree: Print the dependency tree to trace conflicts and transitive sources
maven-memo.item-dep-tree-verbose: Also show candidates omitted for conflict, so you see the mediation result
maven-memo.item-dep-tree-filter: Show who pulls in a given group, with * as the artifactId wildcard
maven-memo.item-dep-analyze: Report dependencies used but undeclared, and declared but unused
maven-memo.item-dep-copy: Export runtime dependencies into a folder to assemble a classpath by hand
maven-memo.item-dep-purge: Delete this project's artifacts from the local repository and re-download them, fixing corrupt jars
maven-memo.item-dep-exclusions: Exclude transitive dependencies, typically for logging implementation clashes
maven-memo.item-dep-optional: Do not leak this dependency downstream; consumers declare it themselves
maven-memo.item-dep-display-updates: List updatable dependency versions without touching the pom
maven-memo.item-dep-use-latest: Bump dependencies to their latest release versions in bulk
maven-memo.item-scope-compile: Default: visible at compile, test and runtime, and packaged
maven-memo.item-scope-provided: On the compile classpath but supplied by the container at runtime (Servlet API), not packaged
maven-memo.item-scope-runtime: Not needed to compile, only at runtime (JDBC drivers)
maven-memo.item-scope-test: Test compile and test run only (JUnit), never packaged
maven-memo.item-scope-system: Points at an absolute local jar path; deprecated, avoid in new projects
maven-memo.item-proj-archetype: Generate a project skeleton interactively; prefer the zip from start.spring.io for Spring
maven-memo.item-proj-wrapper: Generate mvnw / mvnw.cmd so the team and CI use the same Maven version
maven-memo.item-proj-mvnw: Build through the wrapper (mvnw.cmd on Windows), no local Maven install required
maven-memo.item-proj-group-id: Organisation identifier, usually the reversed domain name
maven-memo.item-proj-artifact-id: Name of the artifact; installed as groupId:artifactId:version
maven-memo.item-proj-version: Version; a -SNAPSHOT suffix marks a work-in-progress build
maven-memo.item-proj-packaging-pom: Aggregator parent: only declares <modules> and shared versions, produces no jar
maven-memo.item-proj-dependency-management: Pin versions centrally without actually adding the dependency; children omit <version>
maven-memo.item-ts-java-home: "No compiler is provided in this environment": JAVA_HOME points at a JRE, set it to the JDK root
maven-memo.item-ts-cached-failure: A failed download is cached, so retry it with -U
maven-memo.item-ts-last-updated: Repeated "failure was cached in the local repository": delete the markers and build again
maven-memo.item-ts-target-release: "invalid target release": the pom's java.version is above the current JDK, check which JDK mvn -version reports
maven-memo.item-ts-force-settings: Bypass the IDE's bundled Maven defaults and build with the settings.xml you choose
maven-memo.item-ts-pkix: "PKIX path building failed": import the corporate proxy certificate into the JDK cacerts truststore

nvm-memo.title: nvm Cheatsheet
nvm-memo.description: nvm-windows installation and Node version switching cheatsheet

clean.title: Remove the existing Node.js first
clean.detail: Uninstall Node.js from Control Panel, then delete these leftovers or they will fight nvm
clean.code-note: It should fail with "not recognized" — that means the slate is clean

download.title: Download nvm-windows
download.detail: Pick the latest setup package on the GitHub releases page
download.code-note: nvm-noinstall.zip is the portable build and needs manual PATH setup

install.title: Run the setup wizard
install.detail: It asks for two paths only: Location of nvm and Location of nodejs — keep both free of spaces and non-ASCII characters
install.noinstall-value: Use the noinstall archive instead and add the nvm directory to Path yourself

verify.title: Verify the install
verify.detail: In a fresh terminal: nvm version prints a number and nvm lists its subcommands

mirror.title: Switch to faster mirrors
mirror.detail: Append two lines to <nvm directory>\settings.txt, or set them with nvm node_mirror / nvm npm_mirror

first-use.title: Install your first Node
first-use.detail: node and npm stay unavailable until nvm use runs; reopen the terminal after switching

nvm-memo.item-list-available: List Node versions available for download
nvm-memo.item-ls: List installed versions; the active one carries a *
nvm-memo.item-install: Install a given version, or latest
nvm-memo.item-install-arch: Install 32-bit or 64-bit explicitly; defaults to the OS bitness
nvm-memo.item-use: Switch to a version; only then do node / npm work
nvm-memo.item-arch: Show whether node runs as 32-bit or 64-bit
nvm-memo.item-node-mirror: Set the node download mirror; omit the url to reset
nvm-memo.item-npm-mirror: Set the npm download mirror; omit the url to reset
nvm-memo.item-root-show: Show where Node versions are stored
nvm-memo.item-root-set: Change where Node versions are stored
nvm-memo.item-npm-registry: Point npm at a regional registry once node is installed
nvm-memo.item-npm-registry-show: Check which registry npm currently uses
nvm-memo.item-npm-global: Install a global package; reopen the terminal for PATH to refresh
nvm-memo.item-npm-cnpm: Install cnpm as a faster npm stand-in
nvm-memo.item-where-node: Show which directory node resolves to, exposing stale installs
nvm-memo.item-ts-not-switched: node "not recognized": installed but never activated with nvm use
nvm-memo.item-ts-off: Version management switched off; turn it back on
nvm-memo.item-ts-locate-settings: Use this to find the install directory holding settings.txt
nvm-memo.item-ts-insecure: Bypass the server certificate check when downloads fail on SSL errors
nvm-memo.item-ts-proxy-stale: A proxy set earlier blocks downloads; clear it and retry
nvm-memo.item-ts-version: Confirm nvm itself is reachable (also nvm v)

docker-memo.title: Docker Cheatsheet
docker-memo.description: Docker and 1Panel installation, configuration and command cheatsheet

check.title: Check the system
check.detail: Kernel 3.10+ on 64-bit; the distribution decides whether you use apt or yum below

remove.title: Remove old packages
remove.detail: Only clears legacy packages; images and containers under /var/lib/docker stay

repo.title: Dependencies & CN registry
repo.detail: First three lines for Ubuntu/Debian, last two for CentOS/RHEL; mirrors.aliyun.com is an order of magnitude faster

install.title: Install the Docker engine
install.detail: Include docker-compose-plugin or the docker compose subcommand will be missing

start.title: Start and enable on boot
start.detail: status must report active (running) before anything else works

mirror.title: Configure registry mirrors
mirror.detail: Write it to /etc/docker/daemon.json, then reload and restart; mirrors only proxy public images

perms.title: Run docker without sudo
perms.detail: Adds your user to the docker group; takes effect after newgrp docker or a new terminal

verify.title: Verify
verify.detail: Hello from Docker plus your mirrors listed in docker info means it is done

win-wsl.title: Install WSL 2 first
win-wsl.detail: Docker Desktop needs the WSL 2 backend; run these in an elevated PowerShell

win-desktop.title: Install Docker Desktop
win-desktop.detail: Tick Use WSL 2 based engine during setup and leave the rest alone

win-mirror.title: Set registry mirrors
win-mirror.detail: Settings → Docker Engine: paste this in, then Apply & Restart

win-rescue.title: When it will not start
win-rescue.detail: Stuck WSL: wsl --shutdown. Hyper-V conflict: disable hypervisor launch and reboot

panel-pre.title: Requirements
panel-pre.detail: Any mainstream Debian / RedHat based Linux, at least 1GB free memory

panel-install.title: One-line install
panel-install.detail: The official script asks for panel port, security entrance, username and password interactively

panel-info.title: Recover address and credentials
panel-info.detail: Run this whenever you lose the entrance or password; it prints port, entrance and user

panel-firewall.title: Open the ports
panel-firewall.detail: Allow the panel port (18080 in the example) plus 80/443; cloud hosts also need the same port in their security group

panel-verify.title: Check the service
panel-verify.detail: Once status reports running, open the address above in a browser

docker-memo.item-pull: Pull an image; latest when no tag is given
docker-memo.item-images: List local images with their sizes
docker-memo.item-rmi: Delete a local image; remove the containers using it first
docker-memo.item-build: Build from the Dockerfile here; the trailing . is the build context
docker-memo.item-tag: Retag an image so it points at the target registry
docker-memo.item-push: Push to a remote registry; docker login first
docker-memo.item-save: Export to a tar file, then docker load -i on the offline box
docker-memo.item-history: Show layer sizes when an image balloons
docker-memo.item-run-detached: Start in the background, host port 8080 mapped to container 80
docker-memo.item-run-tmp: Drop into a throwaway container that deletes itself on exit
docker-memo.item-run-volume: Bind-mount a host directory so data lives outside the container
docker-memo.item-ps-all: List every container, including exited ones
docker-memo.item-exec: Open a shell in a running container; use sh when bash is missing
docker-memo.item-logs: Follow logs starting from the last 100 lines
docker-memo.item-inspect: Full details: IP, mounts, environment variables
docker-memo.item-stats: Live CPU and memory usage per container
docker-memo.item-rm: Delete a container even while it runs
docker-memo.item-compose-up: Start every service defined in compose.yml, in the background
docker-memo.item-compose-build: Rebuild local images first, then start
docker-memo.item-compose-config: Validate and render the final yml; run this after editing
docker-memo.item-compose-exec: Open a shell inside one service
docker-memo.item-compose-down: Remove containers and network, keep volumes
docker-memo.item-compose-down-volumes: Also delete volumes — this wipes database data
docker-memo.item-volume-create: Create a named volume; easier to move than a host path bind
docker-memo.item-volume-rm: Delete a volume after stopping the containers using it
docker-memo.item-network-ls: List networks; compose creates one per project
docker-memo.item-network-create: Create a network so containers resolve each other by name
docker-memo.item-network-connect: Attach a running container to another network
docker-memo.item-cp: Copy files between a container and the host
docker-memo.item-system-df: Show what images, containers and volumes each consume
docker-memo.item-system-prune: Clear unused images, containers, networks and volumes; destroys data
docker-memo.item-ts-status: Daemon state and the last error
docker-memo.item-ts-journal: dockerd's own log; start here when the service won't come up
docker-memo.item-ts-mirrors: Confirm the mirrors actually took effect
docker-memo.item-ts-masquerade: Containers cannot reach the internet: add masquerade to firewalld
docker-memo.item-ts-dns: Container DNS failures: check which resolver the host uses
docker-memo.item-ts-map-count: Temporary fix when Elasticsearch complains about max map count
docker-memo.item-panel-status: Check 1Panel service state; optionally core / agent
docker-memo.item-panel-user-info: Print panel address, security entrance and account
docker-memo.item-panel-update-password: Change the panel password; same for username / port
docker-memo.item-panel-reset-entrance: Drop the security entrance when you cannot recall it
docker-memo.item-panel-listen-ip: Switch the listening IP: ipv4 or ipv6

photo-cheatsheet.title: Photography Cheat Sheet
photo-cheatsheet.description: Reference image of nine common phone-photo mistakes: distance, angle, obstruction, lighting, shake and focus
photo-cheatsheet.imageAlt: Photo pitfall cheat sheet, nine panels: 01 too close and blurry, 02 odd angle, 03 blocked, 04 only the back of the head, 05 too dark, 06 camera shake, 07 silhouette from backlight, 08 finger in the frame, 09 focus on the wrong subject, with a caption at the bottom
